document.about: TI LM358 data sheet. Its prose is set at 10pt; its tables, pin diagrams and drawings set many more lines at 8pt.

notes: 2026-11-26 (#403): with the body measured at 8pt, 10pt labels of its drawings (`VOUT`, `Package`) were headings by size. Measured from its prose, the body is 10pt.

Open: the revision history's bold heads (`Changes from Revision AA … to Revision AB …`) are set bold at the body's size now, each on one row with the bold `Page` label over its list's page column, and two bold lines side by side read as a table's header cells. On main both were headings by their size.

checks.issue: #403: a drawing's 10pt label was an h4.
